display.purpose: Hero masthead only; Archivo 800, clamp 3.5–6rem, tracking -0.04em.

section.purpose: Section titles under a strong rule; Archivo 800, clamp 2.25–3.75rem.

headline.purpose: Reader and major entry headings; Archivo 700.

stat.purpose: Tabular counters in the ruled index row; Archivo 700.

body-lead.purpose: Section subtitles and reader descriptions; Source Sans 3, 1.0625rem.

body-sm.purpose: Supporting copy and captions; Source Sans 3, 0.875rem.

mono.purpose: Dates, tags, and measurement text; JetBrains Mono, 0.875rem.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Default resting state for every surface; depth comes from rules and spacing.

shadows.name: lightbox-focus
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on icon controls over the dark media viewer only.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: One quiet entrance for supporting content.

motion.name: slide-up
motion.purpose: Section-level entrance from an already-visible default.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Honors prefers-reduced-motion across every animated element.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink action used at contact and form submission points.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid var(--color-text-primary); border-radius:0; background:var(--color-text-primary); color:var(--color-bg-primary); font:600 14px/1.3 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:transparent; color:var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-text-primary); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet outlined counterpart for dismissive or alternate actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid var(--color-border-secondary); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--color-text-primary); font:600 14px/1.3 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-text-primary); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Underlined text link used for the hero's two navigation actions.
components.css: .ds-text-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding-bottom:4px; border-bottom:1px solid currentColor; color:var(--color-text-primary); font:600 14px/1.3 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:opacity 200ms ease; } .ds-text-action:hover { opacity:0.6; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-text-primary); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Square 40px control for theme, language, and media navigation.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Next"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 18l6-6-6-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:40px; height:40px; border:2px solid var(--color-border-primary); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--color-text-secondary); cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { border-color:var(--color-text-primary); color:var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-text-primary); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Underline-only text field used in the contact form.
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; } .ds-field span { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--color-text-secondary); font:500 11px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field input { display:block; width:100%; padding:12px 0; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid var(--color-border-secondary); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--color-text-primary); font:400 16px/1.65 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:var(--color-text-tertiary); } .ds-field input:focus { outline:none; border-bottom-color:var(--color-text-primary); }

components.name: Ruled Tag
components.description: Square mono label for featured work and technology counts.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:3px 7px; border:2px solid var(--color-border-primary); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--color-text-secondary); font:400 11px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:0.02em; }

components.name: Ruled Card
components.description: Flat, square entry surface; hover changes only the rule color.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:24px; border:2px solid var(--color-border-primary); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--color-text-primary); font-family:'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; transition:border-color 250ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-card h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font:700 18px/1.3 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.01em; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:var(--color-text-secondary); font-size:16px; line-height:1.65; }

components.name: Code Ledger
components.description: The hero's ruled code specimen under a version stamp.
components.css: .ds-ledger { border-left:2px solid var(--color-border-primary); padding-left:40px; } .ds-ledger-head { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding-bottom:12px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--color-text-primary); color:var(--color-text-tertiary); font:500 11px/1.5 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-ledger-code { margin:20px 0 0; color:var(--color-text-secondary); font:400 12px/1.75 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; white-space:pre-wrap; }

components.name: Reader Sheet
components.description: Flat modal sheet for project and blog readers.
components.css: .ds-reader { max-width:900px; margin:auto; padding:56px 40px; border:2px solid var(--color-border-primary); border-radius:0; background:var(--color-bg-primary); color:var(--color-text-primary); font-family:'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-reader h2 { margin:0 0 16px; padding-bottom:28px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border-primary); font:800 clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px)/1.15 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.025em; } .ds-reader p { margin:0; max-width:68ch; color:var(--color-text-secondary); font-size:16px; line-height:1.65; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is one continuous proof sheet: paper-white or near-black ground, strong dark rules, square corners, and typography doing all the structural work. The name and the work are the evidence. Nothing floats, glows, or blurs; precision is the craft being sold, so spacing, alignment, and measured type carry the identity.

The page reads as a ruled index of proof: masthead, about, projects, technologies, writing, contact. Each section uses the same left-aligned header, the same dark grey rules, and the same flat surfaces. Light is a cool paper ground; dark is the same system on near-black. Motion is sparse and exponential, never decorative weather.
keyCharacteristics: Strictly greyscale interface; no signal hue, gradient text, or colored glow. Only media and technology marks carry color.
Archivo for masthead and headings, Source Sans 3 for reading, JetBrains Mono for code and metadata.
Emphasized 2px structural rules, 1px internal rules, flat transparent surfaces, square corners, tabular numerals.
A three-column stat index and a flat code ledger instead of floating cards.
Project/blog imagery and video in full color; technology marks in their own brand hue.

rules.name: The Strong Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from visible dark grey rules and alignment, never from glow, blur, or colored borders. Containers carry 2px; internal separators carry 1px.

rules.name: The Greyscale Interface Rule
rules.body: Every component, glyph, and state uses neutral greys. Technology marks and project/blog media keep their original color because they are the evidence.

rules.name: The Tight-But-Legible Rule
rules.body: Display tracking never goes past -0.04em; body copy never passes 75ch. Emphasis comes from weight and scale, not color.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: A surface is a sheet on the ground, not a floating object. If it needs separation, use a rule or spacing.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: A radius would make an entry feel like a card. Keep the corner square and let the rule define the edge.

dos: Do align entries to the 84rem container and its 1.25/2/3rem gutters.
Do use 2px rules in Rule (#7c858c) or Night Rule (#68727a) for structure, and 1px internal rules for fine separators.
Do keep display tracking at -0.04em or looser and body measure within 65–75ch.
Do ship project/blog photography and video in full color; the work's own hue is part of the proof.
Do keep every interface glyph grey, and leave technology marks their official brand color.
Do use tabular numerals for counters, dates, and carousel positions.
donts: Don't reintroduce gradient text, glass blur, colored glow, or noise/mesh decoration; the user replaced them.
Don't add a kicker or eyebrow above a heading; the heading carries its own weight.
Don't use rounded pills or floating metric cards for the hero index.
Don't let small text fall below 4.5:1; Ink Tertiary and Night Tertiary are the lightest allowed small-text values.
Don't invent credentials, metrics, or testimonials; the proof sheet only shows existing facts.
